root_cause.text: The IPA v5.0 register definition incorrectly used the obsolete `ERINDEX` identifier instead of `CH_ERINDEX` in the `reg_ch_c_cntxt_1_fmask` array, preventing the event ring index from being properly configured in the hardware.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the replacement of `[ERINDEX]` with `[CH_ERINDEX]` in `drivers/net/ipa/reg/gsi_reg-v5.0.c`, and the CVE description states the v5.0 register definition "used the old identifier of ERINDEX instead of CH_ERINDEX."
